content.text: Where to go, where to stay, what to eat, and how to make the most of your time in one of Europe’s most charming cities.This detailed travel guide covers everything you need to know....Porto, Portugal: What First-Time Visitors Should Know Before Going We’ll explore top attractions like Clérigos Tower, São Bento Station, the Dom Luís I Bridge, and the city’s famous port wine cellars — plus I’ll share some local favorites, hidden gems, and insider tips to help you plan your trip like a pro.
